propositions: workflow_ms aggregates multiple internal operations but lacks subphase attribution, preventing performance diagnosis and expectation-setting

the completion workflow call path must be decomposed into concrete non-overlapping subphase boundaries (precheck/context, completion-agent, reconcile, no-LLM passthrough, unclassified-step) whose sum reconciles to workflow_ms
instrumentation must measure only in-process monotonic clock reads at existing seams without adding LLM calls, Git work, filesystem snapshots, network requests, retries, or subprocess work
subphase durations plus an explicit residual must reconcile to the aggregate within documented rounding tolerance (1 ms serialization margin) and preserve backward compatibility with older sidecars
the reusable duration probe must validate metric emission, partition arithmetic, and legacy sidecar compatibility via CI coverage without relying on local resource constraints
